title: ZCC company info and password management calls: who may read, and which clients can write

prose.text: Company info holds tenant-wide flags such as support access and logging controls, and `managePass` sets app profile passwords in bulk. {{terraform-data-source-only}} The Python SDK writes neither, as the sections below show.

prose.label: Reading company info.
prose.text: {{company-read-access}} The Python call returns a list: [[zcc.sdk-python.return-shapes:company-info-list]].

prose.label: Password management.
prose.text: {{manage-pass-contract}} {{manage-pass-python-model-only}} The Go SDK's call sends an empty object instead of the payload: [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling:zcc-request-do-double-marshals]]. Legacy mode does the same: [[zcc.sdk-go.paging-and-requests:legacy-body-encoded-again]].

checks.do: Whether a manage-pass write went through the Go SDK, whose body is an empty object, or was built by hand against the contract.
Whether a company-info update relied on `setCompanyInfo`, which only the Go SDK documents.

company-read-access.statement: The contract and the Python docstring say `getCompanyInfo` is allowed when the caller is a OneAPI customer or the token has admin or read-only admin privileges.

quotes: Note: This API endpoint is allowed if called via OneAPI or if the token has admin or read-only admin privileges.

expect.description:
Gets information about your organization such as the name of the business, domains, etc.

Note: This API is allowed if the caller is a OneAPI customer or if the token has admin or read-only admin privileges.

terraform-data-source-only.statement: The Terraform provider exposes company info only as the `zcc_company_info` data source; it has no company-info resource.
terraform-data-source-only.conditions: Added per verifier, who found the earlier sentence unmarked. Absence: no file under internal/framework/resources of the provider handles company info (searched at the pin).

set-company-info-go.statement: The Go SDK writes company info with `PUT /setCompanyInfo`, treats any `success` other than "true" as a rejection, and on success re-reads the configuration with `getCompanyInfo` and returns that.

set-company-info-undocumented.statement: The captured contract has `getCompanyInfo` but no `setCompanyInfo` operation, and the Python SDK has only the read.
set-company-info-undocumented.conditions: Absence: no contract path contains setCompanyInfo, and zscaler/zcc/company.py defines only `get_company_info`.

company-info-mixed-types.statement: The Go `CompanyInfo` type mixes encodings on purpose, because the payload does: some flags are numeric strings such as "0" and "1" (for example `proxyEnabled`), others integers (for example `supportEnabled`, `fetchLogsForAdminsEnabled`, `supportTicketEnabled`, `disableLoggingControls`).

quotes: are returned as numeric strings like "0"/"1" while others are integers).

manage-pass-contract.statement: The contract defines `POST /managePass` with a body naming a company, a device type, a policy name and the exit, logout, uninstall and per-service disable passwords, and a response carrying only `errorMessage`.

manage-pass-python-model-only.statement: The Python SDK ships a `ManagePass` model but no service method that sends it, so `managePass` cannot be called through the Python SDK.
manage-pass-python-model-only.conditions: Absence: no module under zscaler/zcc other than the model references ManagePass, and ZCCService has no manage-pass property.
